lines.text: Belorta, Emma, Mica and I get started on making the cake.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: The first thing we have to do is prepare the cake batter.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I guess I could do that. Emma, can you help pour the milk for me?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Sure!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I'll fill the strawberries with chocolate.
Fill them with chocolate?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Yep! Sounds delicious, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: You can help me, Old-Timer.
No thanks.
Sorry, but I'd rather not♡

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Okay, no problem. I'll just be sure to put some hot sauce in your strawberries.
I promptly change my mind and help Belorta inject chocolate into the strawberries while Mica and Emma work on the cake batter.
*Drip*

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: This isn't too fast, is it?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Nope, that's perfect. Keep pouring it just like that.
*Glug glug glug*

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Oh dear...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'm terribly sorry. I wasn't able to control it.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I-it's okay. We can just add more flour.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: You're so smart, Mica.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: ... Hehe. All right then, I'm gonna keep stirring the batter, so go ahead and gradually add some more flour.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Okay, I've got this.
Emma brings over the cake flour and starts pouring it into the bowl bit by bit.
*Tap tap tap*

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: This is much easier with a powder than a liquid.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Glad to hear it. Just keep adding it slowly like you're doing. A bit more...
*Pour*

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: ... Oh dear.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Ha, just look at all that powder in the air! It's like it's snowing.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I don't understand... I swear I had a good grip on it.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'm so sorry. I feel just terrible.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I had no idea it would all come tumbling out like that.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Should we start over?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: No, no, that's all right. We've got a lot of milk in here, so it should be okay.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: It'll just be an extra large cake, that's all.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Oh, well that's good! Sounds like you've got a real knack for baking, Mica.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Yeah, Mica is a natural at this.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Anything she bakes is out-of-this-world delicious.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: That's not true at all...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I knew I could trust you with this! All right, Mica, what should I do now?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Now, all we've got to do is add a bit of sugar.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hmm... perhaps the Commander should step in?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'm nervous that I might mess it up again.
Sure.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Thanks, Commander.
*Tap tap*
I gently shake the jar of sugar, gradually adding bits of sugar.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: That's it. You're doing great, Old-Timer.
You don't need to encourage me. I'm just holding a jar of sugar...

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: That's it, just like that. A little bit more...
*Pour*
A massive wave of sugar suddenly comes rushing out of the jar.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: ... Oh dear.
... Aren't you going to say that it's okay?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I'm... I'm more worried whether you're okay, Old-Timer.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: As for the cake... I'm not so sure I can say it's okay.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Hehe!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: How about that? Even Old-Timer dropped the ball.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Sorry!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I figured since no one else was saying anything, I might as well say it.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Anyway, it shouldn't be too big a deal, right? It'll just be a bit on the sweet side.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: R-right!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: It'll be a little sweeter, and a little hefty, that's all.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Sorry for not saying anything earlier. I just needed a moment to think.
... It's okay.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I'll try and work my magic with this thing and make sure it ends up delicious.
Thanks.
A moment later.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: All done!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Wow, it's massive! Must be because we put in so many ingredients.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: It smells wonderful.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: It's a bit plain looking though, don't you think?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Wouldn't it pop more with a bit of decoration on top?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Good call! Do you think you can draw a heart?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: But we don't have enough frosting left for that...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: How about using ketchup then?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: K-Ketchup?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Sure, why not? It's what they do at the Maid Cafe.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I've tried it before and it didn't taste half bad.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: You don't say? I suppose mixing something sweet and acidic could be a good flavor combination.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: We could say that we made a strawberry tomato cake.
I look at Mica, who appears to have disassociated completely.
Whatever I do, I have to stop this from happening.
Otherwise, we're going to have a culinary disaster for the ages.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: W-wait just a moment!
Mica abruptly rushes forward.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Use this.
She is holding a small plastic bag filled with chocolate.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: This should work a lot better.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: The color doesn't really stand out though...

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: What if we drew the pattern on a plate then?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Do you think that might look better?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Oh, I've got it! We can use half and half.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Half with chocolate,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: and half with ketchup.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: What do you think?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Erm... okay...

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I'll do the chocolate then.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: You'd like to draw a pattern too?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Y-yeah... that's what I'd like to do...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Okay!

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Tomato ketchup with strawberry and chocolate...

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Sounds delicious!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Yeah... really yummy... *sigh*
Oh no... it's happening again.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Pff...! Pfft...!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Hahahah!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: You should see your face, Mica. It's hilarious!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: ... Belorta?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Personally, I think our cake is going to be delicious, don't you?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I can't wait to share it with everyone!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I never thought

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: making a cake could be such a riot.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I can't remember the last time I had this much fun.
After decorating the cake with various patterns
using both ketchup and chocolate,
our decidedly slovenly cake is complete.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: The tree is officially complete!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: I think it's the prettiest tree I've ever seen.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: The decorations really are lovely.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: I think so too. Noir and I worked really hard on it.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: You work with the light so well, Delta.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: Like an artist.

lines.speaker: signal
lines.text: The angles are perfect!

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Well, I obviously can't permit any imperfections.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Wow...

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: Did you do this all by yourself?

lines.speaker: delta
lines.text: Eunhwa helped out.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: She did?

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: I don't think she did much of anythi...

lines.speaker: eunhwa
lines.text: Shut your mouth.

lines.speaker: vesti
lines.text: ... Will do.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Hahaha!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Hey, Emma!

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Look over here.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hmm? You've got some frosting on your lip.

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: I know, don't I look like Santa Claus?

lines.speaker: belorta
lines.text: Let me put one on you too.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Ooh, that'd be great! Thanks.
Mica is carefully surveying the surroundings with an inexplicable expression on her face.
What's on your mind?

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: It's just...

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: This is all so different from how I imagined Christmas would be.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Whenever I think of Christmas in my mind, it's filled with people who are forcing themselves to smile.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Here, everyone's smiles are genuine.
You're right.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Maybe Belorta was right. Maybe I had an unjustly negative impression of Christmas.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: After all, this is just about the furthest thing from a depressing Christmas that I can imagine.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I can't imagine anything bad or dangerous happening here.
Christmas is meant to be a festive occasion.
Mica gazes at the other Nikkes, who are all beaming from ear to ear.
